{{Top|ca|leg}}
The '''Grandeel fish farm''' was a type of [[Farm/Legends|farm]]<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> that existed in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Grandeel [[Fish/Legends|fish]] [[Farm/Legends|farms]]|system=[[Grandeel system/Legends|Grandeel system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Grandeel system/Legends|Grandeel system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Reskik]] grew up on a Grandeel [[Fish/Legends|fish]] farm before eventually enrolling in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grandeel fish farm was created by [[Jonatha Ariadne Caspian]] and introduced in the [[1995]] [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of<ref name="GG2-2" /> ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
